topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Oh wow, how did this even happen? You came up with this thing, it’s yours, and now some paperwork says it belongs to someone else? That’s just... I don’t even know what to think right now. I mean, I know you’re probably feeling all sorts of things, but seriously, this has to be a mistake. There’s got to be something we can do, maybe talk to a lawyer or something? Don’t give up on this, okay? This idea is too good to just let it go, and it’s yours, no one can take that away. We’ll figure this out, I promise. Just breathe, let's think this through.
